summary: Frontend-only mobile testing on Expo web preview (390x844). Full happy-path validated: home hero + today total, FAB → Novo gasto modal, amount entry as cents (digitar 5000 → R$ 50,00), category picker (12 cats), date today, description, save → router.back → home total updated (R$ 87,50 → R$ 137,50) and new expense appears. Tap expense row opens Editar gasto modal with delete icon. Gastos tab: 7 period chips (period-chips-*) and 13 category chips (incl. 'todas') work. Gráficos tab: 3 range segments (7/14/30d) and 3 comparative segments (Dia/Semana/Mês) functional, bars + donut rendered. Config tab: resumo com fixos R$ 1.355,00 (74%), menu-fixos e menu-categorias visíveis. Categorias (cat-add → cat-save) e Gastos fixos (fixo-add → fixo-save, 3 seed fixos: Aluguel/Internet/Netflix) abrem corretamente. Seed de 12 gastos nos últimos 7 dias confirmado (Últimos 7 dias total R$ 747,50). No deprecated expo packages detected. One non-blocking React warning surfaces as a user-visible error toast (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: React dev warning 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?' is being surfaced to users as a visible red error toast on top of the UI (seen on Gráficos, Config, Fixos screens). Warning originates from a third-party SVG/chart component (not from app source). Users should not see internal console warnings; filter non-fatal warnings in the custom toast/ErrorBoundary, or fix the invalid DOM attribute at the chart component (react-native-svg / donut). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/toast.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/category-donut.tsx or daily-bar-chart.tsx

issues: FAB floats over the 'Últimos 7 dias' panel on home at viewport 390x844, slightly overlapping the 'Média/dia' value area. Consider adding extra bottom padding to the ScrollView when FAB is present (currently paddingBottom: spacing.xxxl * 2, but FAB sits at bottom:60+insets+12).

action_items: Fix or suppress the user-facing error toast surfacing dev warnings (Invalid DOM property transform-origin). Either (a) filter non-fatal console warnings in the custom toast system so they don't render for end users, or (b) fix the underlying prop in the chart component triggering it.
Slightly increase ScrollView bottom padding on home so the FAB doesn't overlap the 'Últimos 7 dias' panel on small viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: expense-form.tsx uses a hidden TextInput + Pressable overlay for amount entry — works on web, but ensure autoFocus/keyboard works on iOS/Android native (web preview tested only).
Date-next button is correctly disabled when dateISO >= today (no future dates allowed) — good UX guardrail.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created by test agent — app auto-seeds on first run via AsyncStorage (verified: 12 expenses in last 7 days + 3 fixos: Aluguel/Internet/Netflix + 12 default categories).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% local-first using AsyncStorage. All testIDs documented work. Amount input accepts digits-as-cents ('5000' → R$ 50,00). Modals open as separate routes (expo-router presentation:'modal'). To test modals via Playwright, click FAB/row and page navigates to /add-expense or /edit-expense/:id. Use chr(34) trick for quotes in dynamic testID selectors inside f-strings. All 4 tabs render correctly.
rca_of_issue: Error toast 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' originates from React's warning when a web-only DOM prop uses kebab-case instead of camelCase. Most likely emitted by a chart dependency when rendered through react-native-web; the custom toast component is capturing console.error output and displaying it to users. Fix: whitelist/suppress React dev warnings in the toast layer (only show app-level errors) OR locate the chart element passing 'transform-origin' and switch to 'transformOrigin'.
